name: 武当山金殿
title: 武当山金殿
text: 武当山金殿，位于中华人民共和国湖北省丹江口市武当山天柱峰顶，全国重点文物保护单位。此处在元代原本有一座铜质金殿，明朝永乐年间将原金殿移走，改建了一座更大的金殿，是为现存金殿。该金殿下方建有须弥座，主体建筑为四坡重檐式殿宇，殿内供奉真武大帝。建筑主体部分均在北京铸造完成，其余围栏部分则由云南昆明的信众捐资铸造。

image.title: Wudang_Mountain_(54131537640).jpg
image.author: xiquinhosilva
image.caption:
Wudang Mountain, located in Hubei, China, is revered as the most sacred Taoist mountain in the country and is known as the birthplace of Tai Chi. This UNESCO World Heritage Site boasts an impressive ancient building complex set amidst stunning natural scenery. 

The mountain has a rich history dating back to the Spring and Autumn Period and has been a significant site for Taoist religious activities throughout the ages.
